checks.name: scoped-hashed-native-address
checks.run:
from mission_control.linux_vault import address
x=address('DriveMedia/synthetic/one')
assert isinstance(x,dict) and x['application']=='WMM' and len(x['address_sha256'])==64
assert x!=address('DriveMedia/synthetic/two') and x!=address('drivemedia/synthetic/one')
